chunks: "Whoever performs hajj one year and then leaves it the next, alternating years, is among those who are devoted to hajj."

key_terms.أَدْمَنَ: persisted in regularly; was constant in
key_terms.الصَّادِقُ: Imam Jaʿfar ibn Muhammad al-Sadiq عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: Does performing hajj every other year count as being constant in hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages regular observance of hajj even if it is not performed every single year. It teaches that maintaining the practice in alternating years still counts as being devoted and constant in hajj.
